The '''Masked Wookiee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
The Masked Wookiee was a patron of [[The Chasm]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the city of [[Gadrin]], on Cularin. The Wookiee was present when the cantina was attacked by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], who was in disguise as the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nek Lawsirk]]. The next day, the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating the incident, asked the Wookiee a few questions about what had happened.
